You Are More Than Individual Heroes

In Bad Eden, players do not act alone.

You are members of a Faction — an organization working to repair the broken world.

Your characters explore, negotiate, and fight on the ground, but the faction provides the resources, structure, and long-term strategy that make real change possible.

Think of your faction as the collective force behind your actions.

What a Faction Represents

A faction is an organized group of people attempting to shape the future of the world.

Your faction may be:

• a reconstruction effort
• a philosophical movement
• a community rebuilding civilization
• a coalition of explorers and problem-solvers

Whatever form it takes, the faction becomes the central engine of the campaign.

What Factions Do

Factions operate on a larger scale than individual characters.

They are responsible for:

• developing territory
• organizing travel and exploration
• managing resources
• confronting large threats
• advancing the Great Work

While characters solve immediate problems, factions shape the long-term direction of the world.

Faction Territory

A faction’s power comes from the hexes it controls.

When your group develops and stabilizes a region, it becomes part of your faction’s territory.

Territory provides:

• resources
• strategic positioning
• travel routes
• influence in the world

As your faction grows, protecting and managing this territory becomes increasingly important.

Operations Points (OP)

Factions use a resource called Operations Points, often shortened to OP, to perform strategic actions.

OP represents the faction’s collective capacity to act.

It includes things like:

• manpower
• political influence
• economic resources
• organizational coordination

Factions spend OP to perform major activities such as:

• developing hexes
• conducting raids
• organizing large expeditions
• building infrastructure

OP is one of the most important resources your faction manages.

Faction Health

Factions are not just defined by territory and resources.

They also have internal conditions that reflect how stable and successful they are.

Common faction metrics include:

• Morale – how hopeful and motivated the faction is
• Loyalty – how strongly people believe in the faction’s leadership
• Unity – how well the faction works together
• Victory – the faction’s success in achieving its goals
• Darkness – corruption or destructive influence affecting the faction

These tracks represent the emotional and political health of the organization.

A strong faction can weather crises.

A weak faction may collapse under pressure.

The Faction Turn

While characters act moment-to-moment during play, factions operate through a structure called the Faction Turn.

During a faction turn, the organization decides how to use its resources.

This may include:

• spending Operations Points
• developing territory
• launching raids
• responding to threats
• organizing strategic activities

The faction turn represents the larger movement of time and strategy within the campaign.

Strategic Activities

Factions can perform large-scale actions known as Strategic Activities.

These represent coordinated efforts that go beyond what a few individuals can accomplish.

Examples include:

• rebuilding infrastructure
• organizing community support
• conducting large investigations
• improving logistics networks

Strategic activities help transform small victories into lasting progress for the world.

Raids

Sometimes factions must confront powerful threats.

These conflicts are resolved through Raids, which represent large-scale struggles between organized forces.

Raids may involve:

• hostile factions
• dangerous creatures
• corrupted infrastructure
• powerful bosses

Characters contribute directly during raids, but the outcome often depends on how the faction uses its resources and tactics.

Growing Your Faction

Over time, factions evolve.

As your campaign progresses, your faction may gain:

• new territory
• stronger infrastructure
• greater influence
• improved strategic capabilities

This growth reflects the impact your group has on the world.

The stronger your faction becomes, the more ambitious your goals can be.

Factions and the Great Work

Every faction contributes to the Great Work in its own way.

By stabilizing hexes, helping communities, and confronting corruption, factions slowly repair the shattered world.

Each decision you make influences whether the world moves toward:

• harmony
• survival
• or deeper collapse

What Players Should Remember

Three simple ideas define factions in Bad Eden.

1 — Your faction is your shared power

It represents what your group can accomplish together.

2 — Factions operate on a larger scale

They manage territory, resources, and long-term strategy.

3 — Factions shape the future of the world

Every decision affects the direction of the campaign.

In Simple Terms

Your characters are the hands that act in the world.

Your faction is the engine that drives change.

Together they determine whether the broken world moves toward restoration — or falls further into chaos.
